इमरान हाशमी और आदित्य दत्त की जोड़ी फिर मचाने आ गई है धमाका!

दो दशक बाद गनमास्टर जी नाइन के जरिए ये तिकड़ी वापस लौट आई है।
फिल्म में इमरान हाशमी, जेनेलिया देशमुख और अपारशक्ति खुराना मुख्य भूमिका में हैं।
इमरान पुराने अंदाज में जबरदस्त डायलॉगबाजी और एक्शन करते दिख रहे हैं।
कहानी एक पूर्व क्रिमिनल की है जो अपनी प्रेमिका के साथ शांत जीवन चाहता है।
अपारशक्ति खुराना ने विलेन बनकर ट्रेलर में अपनी खौफनाक अदाकारी से सबको चौंका दिया है।
ट्रेलर 2 मिनट 41 सेकंड का है और इसमें हिमेश रेशमिया का संगीत भी है।
इमरान का कहना है कि इश्क में आंसू बहाने का रिवाज है पर वो खून बहाएंगे।
क्या आपको लगता है कि अपारशक्ति का विलेन अवतार इमरान पर भारी पड़ेगा? 🔥🎬🤔

ctx.title: Gunmaaster G9 Trailer Review: Emraan Hashmi Drenched In Aashiqui Follows Ishq Mein Aansoo Bahaane Ka Rivaaj, But I Am Glued To Aparshakti Khurana!
ctx.summary:
Emraan Hashmi is drenched in Aashiqui, revenge, and bloodshed yet again but this time Aparshakti Khurana raises stakes - Gunmaaster G9 trailer review. 
 The post  Gunmaaster G9 Trailer Review: Emraan Hashmi Drenched In Aashiqui Follows Ishq Mein Aansoo Bahaane Ka Rivaaj, But I Am Glued To Aparshakti Khurana!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Remember the year 2005? A boy called Aditya Datt united with Emraan Hashmi and Himesh Reshammiya to deliver one of the biggest blockbusters of that decade – Aashiq Banaya Aapne! Two decades later, the trio has reunited for Gunmaaster G9. Starring Emraan Hashmi and Genelia Deshmukh, alongside Aparshakti Khurana, the trailer hints at another Emraan Hashmi blockbuster with every single frame!
Meanwhile, ditching his comedic roots, Aparshakti plays a menacing, cold-blooded antagonist. His creepy recitation of ‘Nani Teri Morni’ turns into a chilling threat and easily steals the spotlight! Clearly, I have my eyes glued to him for this one!
The trailer has everything you expect out of an Emraan Hashmi film! Brilliant dialoguebaazi, a hero drenched in rain, soaked in blood, and mad in love! All set for a revenge! Hashmi is bringing back classic mass punches like “Ishq mein aansoo bahaane ka rivaaj hai, lekin main khoon bahaunga,” delivering the instant nostalgia of the 2000s!
Directed by Aditya Datt, Gunmaster G9 leans heavily into retro-style mass action mixed with intense personal stakes. Emraan Hashmi plays a former criminal legend who puts down his weapons to build a quiet life alongside his ladylove (Genelia Deshmukh). However, when an unhinged enemy (Aparshakti Khurana) comes knocking to destroy everything, he reverts to his deadly, gun-loving avatar.
The 2-minute 41-second trailer relies on pure mass appeal. While the plot line feels extremely formulaic, the snappy trailer edit, stylish shot compositions, and heavy dialogue delivery keep it brilliantly engaging.
Emraan Hashmi fits back into his anti-hero lover-boy space with effortless charm. He delivers high-decibel one-liners with classic authority and carries the grey-shaded action sequences with conviction. Genelia Deshmukh provides a soft emotional anchor to the narrative, though her presence in the trailer is largely confined to being the protective core of the lead character.
The real surprise package is Aparshakti Khurana. Stepping into a sinister villainous role, he brings an unhinged, unsettling intensity that raises the film’s stakes instantly. His terrifying body language and sharp dialogue delivery easily steal the show!
Aditya Datt plays to his strengths by packaging the film with sleek gunfights, heavy vehicle stunts, and nostalgic musical backing by Himesh Reshammiya, and this package looks interesting!
